source.provenance_note: Public mirror of the widely used buildingSMART Duplex Apartment sample.

discovered_compatibility_gap.original_assumption: Space volume must be available as NetVolume/GrossVolume quantity.
discovered_compatibility_gap.observed_export_pattern: Revit IFC2X3 sample contains IfcPropertySingleValue named Volume with IFCVOLUMEMEASURE values.
discovered_compatibility_gap.correction: Importer now prefers standard volume quantities and falls back only to one unambiguous positive Volume property.
